explanation: In Mexico, showing the soles of your feet is considered disrespectful because the foot is viewed as the lowest and dirtiest part of the body. This gesture can be interpreted as a sign of contempt or disregard, especially in social or formal settings.
local_tip: Always keep your feet flat on the floor or crossed at the ankles, and avoid pointing your soles toward anyone during conversations or gatherings.

also_check.note: The feet are considered the lowest part of the body, and pointing them at people or sacred objects is highly offensive.
Showing the soles of your feet is seen as an insult, as the foot is considered unclean.
While generally not a major faux pas, putting feet on furniture or pointing soles at someone can be seen as informal or rude in formal settings.
